Name: Ana's Toned Down Portraits
Author: anatxse
Description:
Vanilla portrait recolors to match my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3943]Toned Down Sprites[/url] mod.

[size=4]Install
[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI to generate the config.json.
[*]Disable any characters you already have overhauls for, the packs will conflict.
[/list]

If you enjoy this mod, consider [url=https://ko-fi.com/anatase]buying me a coffee[/url]!
Submit requests for add-ons in my [url=https://discord.com/invite/DBJgYJjXq9]Discord[/url]﻿, and tag me on [url=https://anatxse.tumblr.com/]tumblr[/url]﻿ if you use my mod ♡

I hope you enjoy my first mod! It was fun to learn and make.
